'''Helen Giessler Grundman''' is an American mathematician.  She is the Director of Education and Diversity at the [[American Mathematical Society]] and Research Professor Emeritus of [[Mathematics]] at [[Bryn Mawr College]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.brynmawr.edu/people/helen-g-grundman |title=Faculty profile at Bryn Mawr |access-date=2017-08-15 |archive-date=2017-08-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170816104845/https://www.brynmawr.edu/people/helen-g-grundman |url-status=dead }}</ref>  Grundman is noted for her research in number theory and efforts to increase diversity in mathematics.

==Education==

Helen Grundman earned her PhD in 1989 from the [[University of California, Berkeley]], under the supervision of P. Emery Thomas.<ref>{{MathGenealogy | id=32704}}</ref>

==Employment==

After receiving her PhD, Grundman spent two years as a [[C. L. E. Moore instructor]] at the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]].  She became a professor at Bryn Mawr College in 1991.  In 2016, Grundman was named as the inaugural Director of Education and Diversity for the American Mathematical Society.<ref>{{cite web|title=AMS names Helen Grundman Director of Education and Diversity|url=https://www.ams.org/news?news_id=3086|website=American Mathematical Society|access-date=12 January 2018}}</ref>

==Research==

In 1994, Grundman proved that sequences of more than 2''n'' consecutive [[Harshad numbers]] in base ''n'' do not exist.{{ran|G94}}

==Honors==

In 2017, Grundman was selected as a fellow of the [[Association for Women in Mathematics]] in the inaugural class.<ref>{{cite web|title=2018 Inaugural Class of AWM Fellows|url=https://awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/2018-awm-fellows|website=awm-math.org/awards/awm-fellows/|publisher=Association for Women in Mathematics|access-date=9 January 2021}}</ref> That same year, she also received the M. Gwyneth Humphries Award from the Association for Women in Mathematics for outstanding mentorship.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Humphreys Award |url=https://awm-math.org/awards/humphreys-award/ |access-date=2026-04-10 |website=Association for Women in Mathematics (AWM) |language=en-US}}</ref>
